subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should this broad issue remain the canonical Anthropic signed-thinking replay umbrella, or should maintainers close it after making https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94228 the canonical remaining prevention tracker?
rationale: The recovery-carrier fixes are on main, but the remaining prevention path changes provider replay semantics and already has multiple open candidate PRs with compatibility and provider-behavior tradeoffs.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until the chosen prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split the remaining variants.

options.title: Make Narrow Issue Canonical
options.body: Close this issue as superseded only after posting a clear handoff to the focused remaining issue and preserving the production evidence links there.

options.title: Defer Prevention Policy
options.body: Treat current-main recovery as sufficient for now and leave prevention to a later provider replay policy review, accepting possible one-shot recovery events.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until the chosen prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split the remaining variants.

likelyOwner.reason: He already triaged the recovery/prevention split in this thread and is the strongest routing signal among the likely owners found in local history and comments.
